def original_receive_ui_cancelled_empty(self):
        """Observe the original unclaimed cancel outcome; never grant work.

        This is distinct from original_receive_ui_idle(): the once-owned Trial
        must already be revoked specifically by cancel. It cannot renew a cap,
        reset the Gate, accept a Session or claim physical RF restoration.
        State then Trial lock order matches the original action/status path.
        Only retained fields/binds and the original HTTP thread are observed.
        """
        try:
            owner, loader, module = self.owner, self.loader, self.owner_module
            if (type(self) is not FixedSession or owner is None or loader is None or
                    type(module) is not types.ModuleType or
                    type(owner) is not module.FixedStateServiceOwner or
                    owner._startup_owner_type_original is not module.FixedStateServiceOwner or
                    owner._startup_namespace_original is not module.__dict__ or
                    module.FixedStateServiceOwner.__init__.__globals__ is not module.__dict__ or
                    owner.loader is not loader or owner.worker is not self.worker or
                    owner.pid != self.pid or owner.until is not self.until or
                    owner.original_until is not self.until or loader._original_until is not self.until or
                    self.receive_trial_requested is not True or
                    self._receive_trial_requested_original is not True or
                    owner.receive_trial_requested is not True or
                    owner._receive_trial_requested_original is not True or
                    owner.start_complete is not True or owner.stop_called is not False or
                    owner.close_called is not False or
                    owner.threads is not owner._threads_original or
                    type(owner.threads) is not list or not owner.threads):
                return False
            http_ticket = owner.threads[0]
            http_thread = owner.thread
            if (type(http_ticket) is not dict or type(http_thread) is not threading.Thread or
                    http_ticket.get('thread') is not http_thread or
                    http_ticket.get('thread_original') is not http_thread or
                    any(http_ticket.get(key) is not True for key in ('initialized', 'called', 'returned')) or
                    http_ticket.get('unknown') is not False or http_ticket.get('failure') is not None or
                    http_thread.is_alive() is not True):
                return False
            service = loader.modules.get('mta_service')
            gate_module = loader.modules.get('mta_receive_trial')
            state, trial = owner.state, owner.receive_trial
            if (type(service) is not types.ModuleType or owner.service is not service or
                    sys.modules.get('mta_service') is not service or type(state) is not service.State or
                    state is not owner._state_original or type(gate_module) is not types.ModuleType or
                    sys.modules.get('mta_receive_trial') is not gate_module or
                    type(trial) is not gate_module.FixedReceiveTrial or
                    trial is not owner._receive_trial_original or trial._lock is not trial._lock_original):
                return False
            with state.lock:
                with trial._lock_original:
                    return (service.State._receive_trial_exact(state) is True and
                        trial is state._receive_trial_original and trial.requested is True and
                        trial.revoked is True and trial.revoke_reason == 'cancelled' and
                        trial.reason == 'cancelled' and trial.expired is False and trial.failure is None and
                        type(trial.claim_count) is int and trial.claim_count == 0 and
                        trial.claimed_operation is None and trial._claimed_operation_original is None and
                        trial.session is None and trial._session_original is None and
                        type(state.native_epoch) is int and type(trial._epoch) is int and
                        state.native_epoch == trial._epoch == 0 and
                        state.state == 'idle' and state.closing is False and
                        state.receive_available is False and state.send_available is False and
                        state.scan_available is False and state.operation is None and state.session is None and
                        all(getattr(state, name) is None for name in
                            ('helper', 'key', 'crypto', 'lease', 'transport', 'worker', 'request')) and
                        state.discoverable is False and state.scanning is False and
                        state.wifi_restore_pending is False and state.radio_restore_pending is False and
                        state.accepted is False and
                        all(type(getattr(state, name)) is list and not getattr(state, name)
                            for name in ('history', 'received')) and
                        all(type(getattr(state, name)) is dict and not getattr(state, name)
                            for name in ('devices', 'peer_seen', 'transfer', 'event_counts')) and
                        state.radio_restore_probes is trial._restore_probes and
                        type(state.radio_restore_probes) is list and not state.radio_restore_probes and
                        state.probe_actors is owner.probe_rows and state.probe_actors is trial.probes and
                        type(state.probe_actors) is list and len(state.probe_actors) == 2 and
                        len(trial._probe_prefix) == 2 and
                        all(a is b and type(a) is dict and a.get('closed') is True
                            for a, b in zip(state.probe_actors, trial._probe_prefix)) and
                        type(state.cancelled) is threading.Event and
                        type(state.decision) is threading.Event and
                        threading.Event.is_set(state.cancelled) is True and
                        threading.Event.is_set(state.decision) is True)
        except (AttributeError, KeyError, TypeError, ValueError, RuntimeError):
            return False
